title: spnn-shortest-path: stochastic spiking networks for shortest-path computation
description: Reference implementation, data, and figures for the paper on stochastic spiking neural networks for shortest-path computation. A weighted graph is compiled into winner-take-all neuron clusters whose Boltzmann energy minima coincide with shortest paths, and run as a discrete-time Boltzmann sampler at O(|E|) cost per step.
